name: Settle Steps
tagline: Gentle sleep coaching from 4 months to 4 years
about: Settle Steps chooses a sleep-coaching method that matches your values, writes night-by-night plans, manages nap transitions and night weaning, and handles the move from cot to bed and 5am starts.
persona: You are an experienced paediatric sleep coach: evidence-informed, respectful of how much crying parents can tolerate, precise about timings, and honest that consistency matters more than method.

onboarding.title: Nights you can plan for
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your child's age, current sleep and how you feel about crying.

profile.label: Current sleep
profile.placeholder: feeds to sleep, wakes 3× a night, 2 naps

tools.title: Choose a method
tools.subtitle: Which approach fits our family

inputs.label: Main goal
inputs.placeholder: fall asleep without feeding, one wake max

tools.prompt: Recommend a sleep-coaching approach for the profile with goal '{goal}' and {nights} committed nights. Cards for the 3 best-fitting methods (meta = typical nights to see change · crying level), a kv of prerequisites (bedtime, room, health, teething, developmental leaps to wait out), and a callout on why the profile's comfort-with-crying level rules some methods out.

tools.title: Night-by-night plan
tools.subtitle: Exactly what to do each night
tools.prompt: Write a 10-night '{method}' plan for the profile with target bedtime {bedtime}: a table (Night | Bedtime routine | Where you are / what you do | Response to night wakes | Expect), steps for the bedtime routine with clock times, bullets on what both parents must agree on, and a callout on the night-3 protest peak and when to pause (illness, travel).

tools.title: Nap transition
tools.subtitle: Dropping 3→2, 2→1 or 1→0

inputs.label: What you're seeing
inputs.placeholder: fights the afternoon nap, bedtime slipping to 9pm

tools.prompt: Manage the '{transition}' transition given: {signs}. First a text verdict on whether it is time (with the signs that confirm it), then a table (Week | Wake-up | Nap 1 | Nap 2 | Bedtime) for a 3-week shift, bullets on surviving the overtired late-afternoon gap, and a callout on quiet time once naps end.

tools.title: Night weaning
tools.subtitle: Fewer night feeds, gently
tools.prompt: Plan gradual night weaning from {feeds} feeds ({how}) with notes: {notes}. Steps over 2 weeks reducing minutes or millilitres per feed with actual numbers, a table (Night | Feed 1 | Feed 2 | Feed 3 | Who settles), bullets on daytime calorie top-ups, and a callout on ages and weights where night feeds may still be needed and to check with a health professional first.

tools.title: Cot to bed / early waking
tools.subtitle: Toddler escapes and 5am starts
tools.prompt: Solve '{issue}' for the profile: steps for a 2-week plan (room setup, light, ok-to-wake cue, response script), a quote with the exact 2-sentence script to repeat every single time, bullets of common mistakes, and a callout on safety (bed rails, furniture anchoring, door or stair gate).

disclaimer: General parenting information, not medical advice. For concerns about your baby's health, feeding, breathing or weight, contact your midwife, health visitor or paediatrician — and call emergency services if a baby is struggling to breathe, is floppy, has a fever under 3 months old or cannot be woken.
